institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin + rituximab/cyclophosphamide/doxorubicin/prednisone)
supportiveCare: PJP + antiviral prophylaxis; hepatitis B screen before rituximab
Two additional rituximab doses (cycles 7 and 8) after the 6 combination cycles
monitoring: Peripheral neuropathy (polatuzumab, an anti-CD79b MMAE conjugate - vincristine is omitted to limit overlapping neuropathy)

drugs.name: Polatuzumab vedotin
drugs.notes: 1.8 mg/kg IV on day 1 of each 21-day cycle, for 6 cycles.

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.notes: 375 mg/m2 IV day 1; continue for 2 further doses after cycle 6.

drugs.name: Doxorubicin
drugs.notes: 50 mg/m2 IV day 1. Track cumulative anthracycline exposure.

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.notes: 100 mg PO daily, days 1-5. Vincristine is intentionally omitted from the R-CHOP backbone.
